title: On the local conformal structure of Imaginary Liouville theory
summary: Imaginary Liouville theory was recently proposed as a path integral construction of a non-rational conformal field theory (CFT) with central charge less than one (Usciati et al. 2026). In the present work, we establish Ward identities and Belavin-Polyakov-Zamolodchikov differential equations in this framework, assuming a precise conjecture on the decay of the Laplace transform of Imaginary Gaussian multiplicative chaos. These results provide a first step towards a rigorous implementation of the conformal bootstrap program for conformal field theories with central charge lower than one. This…
